maintenance_led.reason: Buys defaulted consumer receivable portfolios from banks and collects on them; not repair, servicing or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue is collections from consumer debtors on purchased bank and credit card receivables, paid by private individuals.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by purchasing receivable portfolios and collecting them, not by acquiring companies; Cabot and other deals are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Banks selling receivables can switch debt buyers easily by price; consumers have no choice but it's not a supplier relationship.

notes: Portfolio purchases are priced competitively, so mission-critical is a judgment call.
